description: A record whose constructor validates its data so an invalid instance can never exist.
A sealed interface of records that models every outcome of an operation, such as loaned, already loaned or unknown.
A switch over a sealed type without default, so adding a case becomes a compile error until it is handled.
A Map method that stores a value only when the key is new and returns the existing value otherwise.
A filter, sorted and collect pipeline over the stored values that answers a question without a manual loop.
An early return that handles an unusual case first, so the main path stays flat.
